claim: WeftForge implementation acceptance only; reference behavior remains unobserved

provenance.expectations_derived_from: original fixture, reviewed contract and clarification; no candidate output was read

root_binding_required_before_launch.record_destination: ROOT-BINDING.json supplied by root after reviewing FREEZE.json; do not edit the frozen PLAN

common_protocol.runtime_targets: Only the bound WeftForge native binary and actor-owned disposable inputs/outputs
preflight: Root binds and hashes the exact final source/native binary and this frozen packet before launch; verify the same hashes after the case.

Import the pinned recorder with createRequire from node:module; never assume require or process globals in CUA. Prove offline module load, one before/returned pair and raw-artifact SHA receipt before launch. Record that preflight separately from native calls.

The CUA first-invocation documentation rule still applies. Pair a mandatory bootstrap API externally if necessary; use only documented APIs and import the recorder into the actual actor runtime before launch. Unsupported module import is a stop, not an assumption.

Create actor-owned byte-identical read-only input copies; record original/input primary SHA and mode before and after. Leave their parent directories writable so normal authoring sidecars can be recorded.

Inventory actor-owned autosave/recovery sidecars before and after each saved state with path, size, SHA, native revision where parseable and originating step; sidecar creation is allowed. Never require no sidecars while authoring. Do not modify the original laboratory fixture.

Observe the current app/screen before choosing every UI target. Coordinates, selectors, file-dialog fields and rotation-handle positions are not predeclared guesses. Keep all screenshots unedited and hash their original bytes.
common_protocol.call_recording: Pair every native API call, including bootstrap, launch, snapshots, waits, input, dialogs and quit, with before/returned UTC and monotonic records. Reserve enough calls/time for final saved-state evidence and quit. Do not issue a call that exceeds the cap.
common_protocol.clock: Case elapsed time starts immediately before launch and includes observation, dialogs, captures and quit; offline preparation precedes this clock.
common_protocol.failure_policy: Any unexpected error, ambiguous target/result, cap exhaustion or unmet criterion stops that case unverified. No retries, fixture edits, output repair, criteria relaxation, CLI substitutes or case merging. Predeclared invalid-input correction and Undo/Redo are planned actions, not retries.
common_protocol.decisive_evidence: Native paired trace plus unedited screenshots prove UI actions/states; native saved files plus the frozen offline grader prove authored results. Passing saved-file grading alone never verifies UI behavior.
common_protocol.focus_gate: No explicit OS focusedAXTextField property gate; retain observed raw text and available native focus/caret evidence without assuming an AX role. Do not alter old unrelated closed cases.

tolerances.history_and_reopen_fields: exact authored fields after replacing only the declared revision

cases.input: actor-owned read-only exact original fixture copy, R37
steps: Launch the bound app with the A input. Observe original piece 2 and partner 11, stopped simulation and native R37. Select Transform pattern and piece 2 through observed controls. Record the original analytic width 1.25 m.

Stage raw width text exactly 1e- on selected piece 2, without submitting it. Attempt to select piece 11 through its observed Scene entry. Require refusal/error, current piece 2, raw 1e- text and draft retained, no construction/history/revision change. Capture the refusal and text.

Correct that same original width to 1.25 and use Tab to leave it. Require no-op R37 and no unintended geometry change; subsequent quarter grading/revision is the saved-state check. Normal cross-piece selection is not claimed by this one refusal trial.

Open Transform pattern modal, change only modal translation U to 0.125, then Cancel/Escape. Require R37 with no construction change. Capture changed modal before cancellation and native state after cancellation.

Reopen Transform pattern modal. With angle 0, V 0 and displayed default pivot (0.125,0.625), type finite U 1000, using Tab between fields. Apply once. Require useful validation error because transformed endpoint U would exceed 1000 m, R37, modal still open and its exact attempted values/drafts retained.

Correct in that retained modal to U 0.5, V -0.25, angle 1.5707963267948966 rad, pivot U 0.25 and pivot V 0.5. Use Tab, never Enter, between fields: Enter may submit the modal. Capture all five final values before one final Apply. Require exactly one authoring transaction R38.

Native Save As to actor-owned quarter.weftforge, R38. Capture native result and path. Undo once to R39; native Save As undo.weftforge. Redo once to R40; native Save As redo.weftforge. Do not type or commit stale inspector values during history/save operations.

In the same process, invoke observed New Empty, capture the empty document, reopen that saved redo.weftforge and require R40. Native Save As reopened.weftforge. Capture reopened native state/path and quit within both caps. This is a same-process reopen claim only.

independent_expectations.unchanged: envelope, exact IDs/order/links/maps/materials/mannequin/resolution/allocator and all untouched piece fields
independent_expectations.compensation: Anew=Aold*Rz(-pi/2); new placement embeds all transformed samples at original world positions; rotated UV grain has unchanged world direction
independent_expectations.history: Undo equals every original authored field with only fresh revision 39; Redo equals every quarter field with only revision 40; reopened equals Redo exactly.

cases.grader: python3 grade_saved.py grade-a A-readonly-input.weftforge quarter.weftforge undo.weftforge redo.weftforge reopened.weftforge
required_captures: Scene refusal retaining raw 1e- and R37
changed cancel modal and cancelled R37

cases.depends_on: fully successful case A, including saved-file grade
cases.input: actor-owned read-only byte-identical copy of successful A redo.weftforge, R40; retain both hashes
steps: In a fresh process, open the B input using the same bound native binary. Observe R40, select Transform pattern/piece 2 and set observed Snap control to 10 mm. Capture snap, selected piece, pivot and revision; do not enable Alt or run physics/export.

From observed boundary/canvas scale, perform one boundary drag targeting displacement +0.10 m U and +0.05 m V. Observe a single preview/release; native Save As translated.weftforge. Require exactly R41 and exact snapped single-addition displacement (0.10,0.05) on every selected endpoint/control. No second corrective drag.

Observe the displayed post-translation bounds-center pivot (0.725,0.175) and actual rotation handle. Perform one visible positive approximately 45 degree handle drag about that pivot, release once and native Save As rotated.weftforge. Require R42. Capture handle/pivot before, gesture evidence and native saved result; quit within caps. No numeric angle correction.

independent_expectations.translation_grading: exact f64 additions to R40 source, unchanged Euler/grain bits and compensated world surface
independent_expectations.angle_fit: Use only saved points 3 and 4: atan2(cross(before4-before3,after4-after3),dot(...)); require unchanged pair length. Never fit scale, pivot or translation.
independent_expectations.rotation_grading: Apply that proper rigid angle around the predeclared pivot with zero extra translation to every endpoint/control and seven samples of each boundary. Check represented placement right-composition, world surface and grain; exact invariant fields and revisions remain mandatory.

cases.grader: python3 grade_saved.py grade-b A-redo.weftforge B-readonly-input.weftforge translated.weftforge rotated.weftforge
cases.coverage_limit: Coarse real-device gesture check only. It does not prove fixed 1000 px/m, >=100 px-radius 2e-6 m/rad mapping; that strict mapping remains native event-test coverage.
required_captures: R40 Transform selection and Snap 10 mm
boundary drag evidence and translated R41
displayed bounds-center pivot and rotation handle
rotation gesture evidence and rotated R42

coverage_limits: Saved-output grading cannot prove raw text/caret retention, refusal, cancellation, transient preview revisions or the actual physical gesture; root reviews paired trace and unedited captures.
A does not separately exercise normal unstaged cross-piece selection or a pre-existing nonempty Redo branch during refusal; those remain native event-test coverage.
No process-restart persistence, fresh mesh/cloth/solver, physics/export, reference parity, pivot dragging or broad transform feature claim.
Observed native layout may make a case infeasible within its fixed caps; stop unverified rather than retrying or widening the plan.
Local ignored evidence is not published delivery; root owns eventual tracking and clean-checkout registry/map verification.
